statement: When a recognized headphone route is active, the first attempt to raise JustTones's output level above 60% shall display an accessible, non-auditory warning that actual exposure depends on system volume, equipment, and listening duration. It shall not call 60% safe; shall permit cancel or continue; shall reappear after warnings are reset; and shall not repeatedly obstruct adjustment after acknowledgement during the same installation.
title: High In-App Level Warning
